title: Shadows over Innistrad Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel, once Innistrad's guardian, now mad and stained with blood; created by Sorin.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A cathar apostate who no longer sees Avacyn as guardian.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who created Avacyn and must end her.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Markov Manor.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's ancestral home, destroyed.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk scholar whose journal records Avacyn's madness.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker sent to find Sorin who follows Tamiyo's trail.

entities.name: Stitcher Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher inspired by Ludevic's laboratory.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: Owner of a laboratory.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire who reveres the sea.

entities.name: Thaniel
entities.description: A Gatstaf shepherd.

entities.name: Inquisitor Delmund
entities.description: An inquisitor.

entities.name: Renna
entities.description: A Selhoff alchemist.

entities.name: Cosper Lowe
entities.description: Member of the Silbern Guard.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf planeswalker.

entities.name: Radwick
entities.description: A farmer of Gatstaf.

entities.name: Ormendahl, Profane Prince
entities.description: A demon whom the Skirsdag devote themselves to after Griselbrand.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon formerly devoted to by the Skirsdag, now gone.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult devoted to demons.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane under shadow.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A coastal region on Innistrad shrouded by the Nebelgast fog.

entities.name: Drownyard Temple
entities.description: A temple to which all cryptoliths point.

entities.name: Silverfur wolfir
entities.description: The last remaining wolfir.

events.summary: Nahiri visits Markov Manor and sends Sorin a clear message.
events.quote: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

events.summary: The destruction of Markov Manor makes the surviving Markovs more dangerous.
events.quote: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

events.summary: Sorin must end Avacyn, whom he created.
events.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

events.summary: Jace is sent to find Sorin and finds Markov Manor and evidence of a deeper mystery.
events.quote: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

events.summary: Jace discovers that all cryptoliths point to Drownyard Temple.
events.quote: This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!

events.summary: Ormendahl quickly takes Griselbrand's place for the Skirsdag.
events.quote: Ormendahl did not make them wait long.

relations.note: The Skirsdag claim devotion to a demon; Ormendahl succeeds Griselbrand.
relations.quote: With Griselbrand gone, the Skirsdag eagerly awaited another demon to claim their devotion.
